How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MOIL Senior Consultant (Project Management Cell) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.moil.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 19-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MOIL Senior Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the MOIL Senior Consultant (Project Management Cell) post is 19th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Engineering/Technology or its equivalent from a recognized institution. Additional qualifications in project management are considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Consultant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Consultant (Project Management Cell) position is 64 years as of 19th August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contract position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 2.00 lakh per month for the duration of the contract.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Senior Consultant (Project Management Cell) in Manganese Ore India (MOIL).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for applying to MOIL recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the experience required for the Senior Consultant role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 15 years of experience is required in the execution, monitoring, and management of mining, industrial, infrastructure, and development projects.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the MOIL Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Consultant (Project Management Cell) position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Manganese Ore India (MOIL) at https://www.moil.nic.in.
